scope: Finite store-to-attention simulation: two KV heads, sparse deterministic BF16 inputs, contexts 2/16/17/33 and three page groups. No physical or universal qualification.
scope_limits: Attention computation at layer zero with two KV heads; publication spans all 28 layers.
Query and K activity is confined to coordinate zero in this deterministic numerical family.
Two deterministic descriptor-delay profiles for numerical/context-one controls; later-group controls use the unstalled profile.
No near-capacity authentication-slot pressure, arbitrary transport stalls, exhaustive numerical proof, physical timing, power or FPGA speed measurement.
